verdict.rationale: The firm's own Patents page names courts, venues and outcomes. It cites multiple UK Supreme Court cases including the FRAND dispute Unwired Planet, and a Court of Appeal win raising the sum due to Optis from Apple to $502 million. It also says the firm has direct experience acting before the Unified Patent Court and runs a UPC decision tracker. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of these case outcomes, and trademark or trade-secret litigation with named courts or outcomes (the brands page mentions only enforcement and anti-counterfeiting strategy).
